answer: personhood attestations bind each agent to a scarce, verifiable credential whose issuance cost scales with stake, so a sybil swarm cannot cheaply fan out identities as ember spawning a plume of smoke. Peers cross-validate these credentials through recursive SNARK aggregation, letting the consensus layer reject duplicate roots with the certainty of a glacier grinding. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
